assumptions: The selected sequence is the frozen Gate 5 N-S-E three-exposure strategy; no sequence offsets, order, rotation, or repeat semantics are changed.
One manually centered configured bundle is modeled; the 3 degree plate and allocation are outside this strategy.
Coverage sampling target N=8 and max_samples=90000 follow the frozen v0.4 project-level coverage contract.
limitations: Individual fiber apertures/gaps, plate allocation/completeness, seeing, atmospheric refraction/depth, actual observatory rotator PA, and facility export are not modeled.
Manual galaxy centers are required; no plate planning, tile lattice, or target allocation is implied.
